decision.comment:
The comparison stage is arithmetically and methodologically sound. Verification: (1) Delta check: 0.917549 − 0.821309 = 0.096240, matching the reported 0.09624. (2) Common seed (42) and split fingerprint (9afc9ed3…c7505) are identical across both reports, confirming a fair same-split comparison. (3) The evaluation confusion matrix row sums equal per-class supports (1338, 847, 339, 634, 1035, 592, 741, 421, 1233; total 7180), and the diagonal sum 6588/7180 = 0.917549, consistent with the reported accuracy. (4) The baseline rationale ('Fixed conventional control with the agentic run's epoch budget') and the 15-epoch budget match the best agentic trial (e15), so the comparison is epoch-matched. (5) No deterministic findings are present, so no stop is warranted.

Carried warnings from prior stages that do not invalidate this comparison but should remain visible in the final dossier: (a) OOD AUROC 0.183 is below random chance and the abstention mechanism is non-functional (abstain_rate 1.0, coverage 0.0, selective_risk 1.0); (b) residual_cnn and resnet18 were never evaluated within the 8-trial search budget; (c) llm_model_digest is null in run_manifest despite llm_model='qwen3.8'; (d) cancer-associated stroma recall is only 0.458 (F1 0.602), the weakest class; (e) the OOD evaluation used a controlled Gaussian-noise corruption proxy only, so the anti-correlation finding is scoped to that family. None of these affect the accuracy comparison itself.

The agentic configuration outperforms the fixed baseline by 9.62 pp on the primary metric (accuracy) under identical seed and split conditions. The comparison is valid and the pipeline may proceed.

Carried warning: Architecture coverage incomplete — residual_cnn and resnet18 never evaluated in the 8-trial search budget
Carried warning: llm_model_digest is null in run_manifest despite llm_model='qwen3.8' — reproducibility traceability gap
Carried warning: Cancer-associated stroma (class 7) recall is only 0.458 (F1 0.602); smooth muscle recall 0.838 (F1 0.802) — histologically similar classes drive most misclassifications
Carried warning: OOD evaluation used controlled Gaussian-noise corruption proxy only; anti-correlation finding may not generalise to other OOD families
Carried warning: Validation-to-test accuracy gap of ~7.3 pp (0.9910 val vs 0.9175 test) should be documented as a known limitation in the final report

ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
